newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton warns about fiscal '97 results.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton warns about fiscal '97 results.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc on Wednesday said it expected its operating earnings for the year ending September 30 to fall short of the Wall Street consensus estimate of $1.15 a share.
The company, which builds single-family houses, said its fiscal 1997 results would show about a 15 percent increase on the prior year, when it reported earnings of $0.87 a share.
The company is "well positioned" for a 30 percent increase in earnings per share in fiscal 1998, it said.

D.R. Horton said its overheads costs in the current year were higher than expected because of delays in reaching operating efficiencies after its acquisition of the Torrey Group. It expects costs to be on track by the beginning of fiscal 1998.
